_comment: SCRUM-2906 R1 — parallel-rig reservation ledger (SCAFFOLD). Machine-checkable source of truth for which isolated staging rig is reserved to which rail/soak, so parallel sessions never double-book a Cloud Run service or a Supabase project (the real isolation boundary per CLAUDE.md 1.11A). Validate with: npx tsx scripts/staging/check-rig-reservations.ts docs/staging/rig-reservations.json. Rows with status='example' are ignored by the double-booking check and exist only to document the shape. Add a real row (status='active') in the SAME PR/session that stands up the rig; flip it to 'released' at teardown. This file is NOT auto-applied and stands up nothing.

reservations.notes: Scaffold example. status='example' is skipped by the double-booking check. Copy this shape for a real reservation and set status='active'.
